To install the large hourly dispatch related datasets when the prebuilt versions are not sufficient you can find them in the folling Git repository (note stored using Git LFS):
https://stash.pnnl.gov/scm/jgcri/gcam-dispatch-data.git

The version last used was at: f37ce90c6d1

Then copy them into the ints/extdata/gcam-usa/dispatch folder.
